retries.reason: attempt1 mismatched 3/4 castles; attempt2 stepped ziggurat

stonehold_capital_district_plan_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: 3/4 axonometric island diorama, facades occluding roofs. Retry is near-ortho roof-plan footprints in an organic oval pocket with a single controlled approach. Rim geology is a bowl, not V013 continent topology. Door ticks weak; use city modules for apertures. Scale numerals not metric authority.

stonehold_capital_skyline_north_south_v0.notes: Attempt1 rejected: 3/4 ziggurat mountain. Attempt2 rejected: piled mountain-city. Attempt3 PASS: flat ortho houses-keep-houses; north rear, south main door. Embermist. No dragons/lava.

stonehold_capital_skyline_east_west_v001.notes: Attempt1 rejected: two different 3/4 castle clusters. Attempt2 rejected: stepped ziggurat. Attempt3 PASS: flat ortho street-wall, houses-keep-houses, labeled east/west, mannequin. Coherent with N/S attempt3.

stonehold_capital_hero_keep_shell_v001.notes: Roof plan + front + side of one battered keep. Wall thickness, walltop stair, punched main door, 1.8 m mannequin. Shell is simpler than skyline keep block; Blender rebuilds enterable keep from this shell plus interior program, not from skyline pixels.

stonehold_capital_keep_interior_program_.notes: Two true top-down furnished plans, not a dollhouse cutaway. Ground: receiving hall, smithing/stores/mess. Upper: command, barracks, armory. Side stairs align. Large streamed combat interior. No lava/dragons.

stonehold_city_street_plan_elevation_v00.notes: Same street: roof-ish plan + front elevation with house/shop/service/workshop mix. Plan still slightly 3/4 on roofs but street width and door ticks readable. Embermist. No dual-gate collage.

stonehold_city_house_module_v001.notes: Front/side/interior plan of one house. Hearth, table, stair to loft, traversable. No modern kitchen.

stonehold_city_shop_module_v001.notes: Hatch-front, side door, furnished plan with counter/stores/loft stair. Iron rolling curtain is material language, not glass shopfront. Plan street door vs hatch: rebuild as hatch + side door.

stonehold_city_service_module_v001.notes: Cistern grate, buckets, dry stores, counter, door swings. No modern plumbing. Traversable.

stonehold_city_workshop_module_v001.notes: Wagon door, chimney side, plan with two anvils, quench trough, coal bunker (not lava), tool racks, 2 m aisle.

stonehold_inner_cave_mouth_v001.notes: Front/side human-scale ore-gallery mouth, timber-iron lintel, mannequin. No dragon skull/eggs/lava.

stonehold_inner_cave_section_circulation.notes: Section + organic pocket plan: gallery, main chamber, alcoves, store niche, portcullis. Walkable floors, labeled 3.2/5.5 m heights are intent only. No boss arena.

stonehold_inner_cave_chamber_kit_v001.notes: Three isolated modules: propped gallery, node chamber with three openings, store alcove. Same language, generous gray, no overlap collage.

stonehold_outer_cave_mouth_v001.notes: War-scarred human dungeon mouth, iron-gold clamps, rubble at threshold. No fortress, no sequential gate, no 30 m apron diagram, no dragon. Rubble is cave talus, not a climb onto a fortress wall.

stonehold_outer_cave_section_combat_circ.notes: Section with shoring + combat plan: mouth choke, looping ring, cover blocks, rear hold. Not a dragon perch or boss podium. No unauthored pits.

stonehold_outer_cave_chamber_kit_v001.notes: Three isolated combat modules: gallery with cover columns, cross-chamber corners, barred hold/alcove. No dragons/lava/fortress.
